body_lead: By- Suhas Birhade VASAI: A 66-year-old woman from Vasai was allegedly duped of Rs 12 lakh after cyber fraudsters used an AI-generated fake video of Tamil Nadu chief minister Vijay to lure her with a promise of financial assistance. A case has been registered at Waliv police station. According to police, on July 27, the woman came across an Instagram reel purportedly featuring Vijay saying he provides financial assistance to the poor and needy and asking those seeking help to contact him. The woman called on the phone number provided in the reel and was given another number to communicate on.
